title: Digiwell Marketing — Growth systems for the AI era

slides.notes: Open warm. One line on who you are, then straight into why we're here: growth systems, not more marketing.
Twenty minutes. Problem, what we build, how it works, one next step. Promise they'll leave with their scorecard.
Section 01. Pause here. Ask: how many leads came in last month that nobody followed up with?
The core reframe. Let the second line land before speaking again. Traffic is rarely the bottleneck.
SAMPLE STAT. Swap for a real client result before presenting. Currently frames the 2-minute scorecard.
Three clicks, one card each. Newsletters (attention), CRM automation (nothing slips), nurture flows (conversion).
Audit, build, launch, optimise. Emphasise done-for-you: they don't need a team to run this.
Read the left column slowly. Most people will recognise themselves. Then the right column is the offer.
One ask only: take the scorecard. Put the URL in chat. Stop talking and leave this up.
